malleability.attack: Related-ciphertext malleability; deliberately naive XOR-mask construction
malleability.defense: Fiat-Shamir proof of ElGamal randomness bound to full AEAD envelope, enforced prior to share release; AEAD integrity additionally checked at final opening.
malleability.caveat: A reproduction of an attack class, not a formal CCA2 proof and not an attack on current Shutter code.

epoch_key_leak.attack: Naive epoch-key release reveals excluded pending transactions
epoch_key_leak.mitigation: Release verified per-ciphertext DH shares only for finalized batch; no epoch private key release.
epoch_key_leak.caveat: Selective decryption costs O(nB) communication; this is not optimized batched threshold encryption.
